reason: I mostly do barter collabs and I'm fine with free food for posts, so a 'customers I brought' record isn't something I'm chasing right now. And Auto-DM means connecting my Instagram to some beta app from a small team, which I'm not doing. I might try the free first collab, but I wouldn't pay for the pass.
objection: Giving an app access to my Instagram feels risky, especially a beta from a small team I've never heard of. If something goes wrong with my account, that's my whole thing gone.
would_change_my_mind: If a few creators in my WhatsApp groups said they used it, their Instagram was fine, and their counts actually got them a paid collab instead of just food.
